html:
Dear UCCians,

We are excited to bring you the latest edition of our monthly newsletter, highlighting all the fantastic cycling accomplishments of the past month.

In the previous month, our club members collectively rode an impressive 657 cycling days. We spent nearly 1,150 hours cycling outdoors, enjoying the fresh air and beautiful scenery of Udaipur.

Together, we covered an impressive distance of 22,875 km, with a total elevation gain of 1,37,703 m. These are incredible numbers, and they demonstrate the hard work and dedication of our club members.

We are incredibly proud of all our members who continue to push themselves and inspire others to take up cycling. We have accomplished so much together, and we have no doubt that we will continue to achieve great things in the future.

So let’s take a moment to celebrate our accomplishments and get ready for another exciting month of cycling. Thank you to all our members for their continued support, enthusiasm, and commitment to the Udaipur Cycling Club.

The Highlights of the Month

Udaipur Cycling Club is proud to announce some remarkable achievements by its members.

  • Sharad Jain has achieved the extraordinary milestone of cycling 50,000 KM. This is a testament to his passion for cycling and his commitment to a healthy lifestyle.
  • Dr Sharad Iyengar is our Commute Rider of the Month. He has been consistent in commuting to work on his bike, which has not only contributed to his health but also helped reduce his carbon footprint. Udaipur Cycling Club applauds his efforts and encourages more people to follow in his footsteps.
  • Dr Akansha Tripathi completed her maiden century, which is a remarkable feat for any cyclist. Her dedication, perseverance, and hard work have paid off, and she has set an excellent example for all aspiring cyclists.
  • Aarav Nalwaya has also completed his maiden century, which is a fantastic achievement. He has shown immense determination and grit to reach this milestone, and Udaipur Cycling Club is proud of his accomplishment.
  • Cycle-A-Thousand Club: The UCC is known for its passion for cycling and its members regularly participate in long-distance rides. Completing 1000 km of cycling in a single month is a significant milestone for any cyclist and requires a great deal of dedication, perseverance, and hard work. In a remarkable achievement, five members of the UCC completed 1000 km of cycling in the month of March. The members are Aashish Chittora, Amarpreet Singh, Dr Anuj Pratap, Mahesh Singhvi, and Nitesh Tak.
  • CycloRunners: Some members of the UCC are exploring their running skills along with their passion for cycling. The members, Dr. Pratik Tantia, Prakash Mali, Rachit Singhvi, and Vikas Khandelwal, are now preparing for upcoming Asia’s largest marathon.
    Some members are training hard and are determined to make a mark in the marathon. They are not only cycling but also running several days a week to enhance their stamina and endurance. Members such as Nitesh Tak, Praveen Kumar (PK), Pravin Jain, Jayant Nanawati, Aish Bisaria, Jayesh Udawat, Aashish, Siddharth Mogra, Dr Anil Gupta, PL Maroo, and Jayesh Rawat are also exploring their running skills and training regularly to improve their fitness levels.

The Incredible Cycling Journey of Sharad Jain

We are thrilled to announce the incredible achievement of one of our own, Sharad Jain, who has completed an impressive 50,000 km on his cycling journey. Sharad Jain joined our club in 2018 and has since been an inspiration to all of us with his unwavering dedication to the sport.
